title: The dream of 18,980! Lilies launch membership offensive –  SV Darmstadt 1898 e.V.
content: SV Darmstadt 98 is entering the new second division season with an ambitious vision: The club's membership is set to increase to 18,980, reflecting the year of its founding. Therefore, SV 98 is calling on all fans and supporters to become part of the Lilien family. To break this milestone, SV 98 has planned many exclusive promotions and experiences for its members for the upcoming season. At the start of the season, randomly selected members were treated to a very special highlight: a members‘ match was played on the Bölle pitch as part of the season opening celebration. Another highlight is also planned after the end of the transfer window: As a symbol of the connection between team and fans, a team photo will be taken together with club members in the stadium. The home jersey for the 2026/27 season is therefore a tribute to the Lily—a mark of tradition, yet also an emblem of the current era.

title: SV Darmstadt 98 - Wikipedia
content: # SV Darmstadt 98. Association football club in Germany. **Sportverein Darmstadt 1898 e.V.**, commonly known as **Darmstadt 98** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ), is a German professional association football club based in Darmstadt, Hesse. The club was founded on 22 May 1898 as FC Olympia Darmstadt. The football department competed in the Bundesliga for the 2015–16 and 2016–17 seasons after a 33-year run in lower leagues. Darmstadt 98 were promoted again to the Bundesliga in 2023; however, they did not avoid relegation the following season. Darmstadt enjoyed a long run as a second division team through the 50s and then again from the time of the formation of the Bundesliga in 1963 on into the 70s. In 2004, the club won the Oberliga Hessen (IV) championship under manager and former player Bruno Labbadia, and were promoted to the Regionalliga Süd (III).
